parole.testo: Probably from Latin cassia, from Hebrew קציעה (qetzi'ah), meaning incense cassia or the cassia tree.

parole.parola: rien de nouveau sous le soleil
parole.significato: there is nothing new under the sun
parole.testo: Calque of Latin nihil sub sōle novum / nihil novī sub sōle, itself a rough calque of Hebrew אֵין כָּל חָדָשׁ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמֶשׁ (“there is nothing new under the sun”).
